summary: The FCC comments express concerns about completely sunsetting the E-Rate program, emphasizing its critical role in maintaining and strengthening technology infrastructure in rural districts. The comments argue that the program has proven invaluable and that connectivity needs will continue to increase and evolve in complexity.
